findings.title: Canonical template documentation substitutes outbound-message outcomes for template submission semantics
findings.rationale: The newly consolidated ST-CON-05 section in integrations-and-channels.md defines error/receipt outcomes as BLOCKED, REJECTED, UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS_SEND_RECORDED and ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE, then describes a positively committed ACK-without-ID diagnostic. Those are ST-CON-06 message-send concepts. The approved D06, CR-02 and Local Commit Certainty Contract instead require template creation without an ID to remain AMBIGUOUS, and known creation followed by unconfirmed local persistence to return TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE with outcome ACCEPTED, providerAcceptance CONFIRMED and receiptPersistence UNCONFIRMED. The embedded TemplateCreateOutcome and TemplateSubmissionService implement that template-specific contract; they do not create the documented message diagnostic. This is fresh drift in the module consolidation, not a reopening of accepted implementation debt. The canonical module now contradicts both the frozen TODO and production source, so DOD-08 module consistency is not yet satisfied despite the supplied module-review receipt.
findings.suggested_action: Correct only the ST-CON-05 field definitions and dispatch/recovery prose to describe the actual template phases, acceptance provenance, providerAcceptance, receiptPersistence and template error codes. Remove the imported message-diagnostic semantics from that section while preserving the existing ST-CON-06 contract. Recheck the module against D06/CR-02/AR-V11-01 and refresh the module-consistency disposition before delivery guards. This documentation correction does not require renewed product approval or another broad test run.
